data.name: Mazinat
data.gender_notes: Mazinat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Growing in knowledge, wisdom and strength, blossoming like a flower. The name Mazinat carries the meaning “Growing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Mazinat usually hope their child will grow to embody growing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a girl who is destined to grow spiritually, to acquire knowledge and wisdom, and to blossom into a beautiful and strong woman
data.etymology: Mazinat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Growing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mazinat total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: مازنة
in_arabic.meaning: مازنة تعني الشخصية الحازمة و القوية في الإسلام
in_arabic.long_meaning: مازنة هي اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي و معناه الشخصية الحازمة و القوية، و يوحي بالثبات و الصبر. و في القرآن الكريم، يوصف الله تعالى بأنه الحكيم و الحازم. و في التقاليد الإسلامية، يعتبر اسم مازنة من الأسماء التي تدل على القوة و الصبر.

in_urdu.name: مازنت
in_urdu.meaning: مازنت کا مطلب ہے مضبوط اور حازم شخصیت
in_urdu.long_meaning: مازنت ایک عربی मूल کا اسم ہے جس کا مطلب ہے مضبوط اور حازم شخصیت۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں قوت اور صبر کی علامت ہے۔ عربی زبان میں، لفظ 'مازنة' حزم اور قوت کے معنی میں प्रयोग ہوتا ہے، جو شخصیت کی مضبوطی اور ثبات کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: माज़िनत
in_hindi.meaning: माज़िनत का अर्थ है मजबूत और दृढ़ व्यक्तित्व
in_hindi.long_meaning: माज़िनत एक अरबी मूल का नाम है जिसका अर्थ है मजबूत और दृढ़ व्यक्तित्व। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में शक्ति और धैर्य का प्रतीक है। अरबी भाषा में, 'माज़िनत' शब्द दृढ़ता और शक्ति के अर्थ में प्रयोग किया जाता है, जो व्यक्तित्व की मजबूती और स्थिरता को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: مازنت
in_pashto.meaning: مازنت د قوي او حازم شخصیت معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: مازنت د عربي اصلي نوم دی چې د قوي او حازم شخصیت معنی ورکوي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتنو په دودونو کې د قوت او صبر نښه ده. په پښتو ژبه کې، د 'مازنت' کلمه د حزم او قوت په معني استعماليږي، کوم چې د شخصیت قوت او ثبات ښيي.

in_english.name: Mazinat
in_english.long_meaning: Mazinat is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, meaning strong and determined personality. It conveys the idea of strength, stability, and resilience. In Islamic tradition, the name Mazinat is associated with the qualities of wisdom, courage, and perseverance. The name is derived from the Arabic root 'm-z-n', which signifies stability and strength.

pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: مازنت

data.cultural_impact: The name Mazinat is of Arabic origin and is commonly used in the Islamic world. It is a beautiful and evocative name that embodies the idea of growth, development, and progress. In many cultures, the image of a flower blooming is a powerful symbol of transformation and new beginnings. Mazinat may be given to a child as a reminder to strive for growth and knowledge throughout their life, or to celebrate a new phase of development or achievement.
data.spiritual_significance: Mazinat means "growing in knowledge, wisdom, and strength," which is deeply significant in Islamic and spiritual contexts. In Islam, knowledge and wisdom are highly valued and seen as essential for leading a meaningful and purposeful life. The name Mazinat serves as a reminder to seek knowledge and wisdom through study, reflection, and spiritual practice, and to grow stronger in faith and character. It also reflects the spiritual journey of an individual, as they seek to deepen their understanding of God, His teachings, and the world around them. By cultivating knowledge and wisdom, those bearing the name Mazinat can blossom like a flower in their spiritual growth and become a radiant source of inspiration and guidance for others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Growing" symbolizes Growing in knowledge, wisdom and strength, blossoming like a flower. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mazinat serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of growing.
